notes.title: STAR WARS™: Episode I: Jedi Power Battles™ - Patch I
notes.content:
[h1]The post-launch patch for STAR WARS™: Episode I: Jedi Power Battles™ is here!  
[/h1]
[h3]Below is a list of resolved issues and various updates.[/h3]

 

[b]Full Changelist: [/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue preventing damage from Adi Gallia’s Ranged Force power.
[*] Fixed an issue where Player 2 was unable to interact with the game after completing a level causing a soft lock.
[*] Fixed an issue where player save data was erased after closing the game.
[*] Fixed a crash upon reaching Level 6 Coruscant elevator.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing Jedi Master Complete the game Trophy on Jedi from unlocking.
[*] Fixed an issue causing an out of save data storage error being thrown when idling on the New Game+ unlocked screen.
[*] Fixed a crash occurring when dismissing Level 10 completion credits in Russian.
[*] Fixed a crash when pressing both 'A' and 'B' simultaneously to dismiss the Mission Goal pop-up.
[*] Fixed a soft lock issue triggered by reconnecting a previously disconnected secondary controller.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing a secondary controller from controlling the game after the primary controller disconnects.
[*] Added missing Legacy visual effects when respawning.
[*] Fixed an issue with combos displaying incorrectly in the award window.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing the "Augie’s Great Municipal Band" Achievement from unlocking on Easy difficulty.
[*] Fixed an issue causing the player character to become stuck near the Level 5 mid-boss area.
[*] Fixed a problem preventing the Combos tab from updating after unlocking new combos.
[*] Fixed an issue causing droid vehicle audio to loop in the background.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing attack SFX audio from playing while the player is using power ups.
[*] Fixed an issue causing the Ultimate Saber toggle to disappear after restarting the game.
[*] Fixed an issue causing the player to die when exiting a moving tank in 2-player mode.
[*] Fixed a crash when using a grenade during the Coruscant level.
[*] Fixed an issue where the title displays Xbox controller button icons when the user is using a Playstation controller.
[*] Fixed an issue where Green Droids ignored Ki-Adi-Mundi's invisibility ability.
[*] Fixed an issue with Sith Probe Drones spawning infinitely if shot from the right side of the screen.
[*] Fixed an issue where Armored Krakkiss boss could knock the player character outside the playable arena.
[*] Fixed issues preventing players from shooting the Vulture Droid boss.
[*] Fixed an issue causing audio to play twice at the end of Level 5 Tattooine.
[*] Fixed a legacy issue preventing droids defeated mid-air from counting towards the mission objectives.
[*] Fixed a legacy issue where dying on a training level after successful completion causes the player to fail the level.
[*] Fixed an issue causing the character to become trapped under a cliff during the Swamps of Naboo boss fight.
[*] Fixed an issue where the camera does not follow the player in a certain segment of the Swamps of Naboo level.
[*] Fixed an issue where players were sent to the last reached checkpoint when attempting to play a stage again after a game over.
[/list]

notes.title: Buy a Game, Help Kids Beat Cancer
notes.content:
Aspyr is proud to announce that we, along with several other publishers, have joined forced with Team17 and GOSH -- Great Ormond Street Hospital Charity -- in their efforts to raise money to build a new Children's Care Center at the GOSH Hospital based in London.

As well as being one of the world's leading children's hospitals, the Great Ormond Street Hospital is the largest for children's heart surgery in Britain and one of the largest for heart transplants in the world. Fun fact: the hospital owns the copyright to Peter Pan. Who knew?

GOSH is running the Play it. Build it. Beat it. sale on Steam until 2/24 and Aspyr is donating ːgetreadyː 100% of its proceeds ːgetreadyː from Heads Up sales during this event to the hospital. The other publishers involved have also pledged to donate a portion of their proceeds to this organization. The sale is chock-full of cozy and co-op games, so buy some games to play with your buds. And make them buy games too. Hey, it's for the kids!

Some highlights from the Aspyr team:

[*] Heads Up! Phones Down Edition ːyouwinː

notes.title: New characters blast their way into STAR WARS™: Episode I: Jedi Power Battles™!
notes.content:
The fight for the fate of Naboo intensifies in the upcoming release of STAR WARS: Episode I: Jedi Power Battles, as four new playable characters join the battle—Flame Droid, Rodian, Gungan Guard, and Destroyer Droid. But the excitement doesn't stop there! Even more newly playable characters will be unveiled leading up to the game's launch on January 23rd, 2025.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246209/e6efebff04bac1de64d82377906ea075928ede60.jpg[/img]

Each new playable character brings unique skills and tactics to the fight, diversifying the action beyond the classic lightsaber duels:

[list]
[*] Flame Droid: Unleashes scorching flames and explosive attacks, blasting enemies with overwhelming firepower.
[*] Rodian: A deadly sharpshooter with exceptional agility, picking off foes from afar with pinpoint accuracy.
[*] Gungan Guard: Armed with trusty spears, this formidable warrior attacks with deadly precision in melee range.
[*] Destroyer Droid: A heavily armored force of destruction, ready to destroy those who attack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246209/4405644c37ae84e4218c57eb91ce63603a89404e.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Four New Characters Join the Battle with More on the Way!
notes.content:
The galaxy grows even more exciting in the upcoming release of STAR WARS™ Episode I: Jedi Power Battles, as four new playable characters are set to join the battle—Rifle Droid, Staff Tusken Raider, Ishi Tib, and the Mercenary. And this is just the beginning. Even more new characters will be revealed in the lead-up to the game’s launch on January 23rd, 2025.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246209/3836c0b2eeba9bc14ee61b38a52d26d6bbb4f36a.jpg[/img]

Each new addition brings a unique fighting style, expanding gameplay beyond the traditional lightsaber battles fans remember from the classic version:  

[list]
[*] Rifle Droid delivers precise, long-range attacks, turning the tide with every shot.  
[*] Staff Tusken Raider conquers in close quarters, using his staff to land powerful strikes and jabs.  
[*] Ishi Tib combines agility and strength for fast-paced melee combat.  
[*] Mercenary blends brute force with tactical attacks, making him a versatile fighter in any encounter.  
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246209/3492e8874f3c73a39f7914a034e6bca429766043.jpg[/img]

These characters offer new ways to experience the action, ensuring every battle feels fresh and exciting. And with more surprises on the way, fans can look forward to a steady stream of reveals in the months leading up to launch.
